dialog.info.title: About Ghostlist
dialog.info.body: Ghostlist finds the ghost records Windows keeps after an uninstall, and it shows its work: every finding lists the evidence behind it and a confidence score. Each fix is backed up on its own first, and program files and personal folders are never deleted.
dialog.noSelection.title: Nothing picked
dialog.noSelection.body: Pick at least one finding from the list first.
dialog.nothingEligible.title: Nothing to fix
dialog.nothingEligible.body: None of the picked findings can be fixed safely. System components, live installations and merely suspicious findings are left alone.
dialog.noAuto.title: Nothing clears the bar
dialog.noAuto.body: No finding reaches {threshold}% confidence with at least {evidence} independent pieces of evidence. Leftover folders and MSIX packages never take part in a bulk fix.
dialog.confirmFix.title: Confirm bulk fix
dialog.confirmFix.body: {count} findings will be fixed. Each one is backed up separately; program files and user folders are not deleted.
dialog.confirmFix.skipped: {count} ineligible findings will be skipped for safety.
dialog.result.title: Done
dialog.result.body: {count} findings fixed, each with its own backup.
